kind: Read-only APK inspection, original author notes, and local fixture test implementation; no access to the user's Xiaomi account
question: Can an independent native-shape history request observe pending rows that the existing overlapping-day and narrowed-end requests do not return?

starting_observation.interpretation: Existing window reads did not return the expected nondeleted source identities. This is not proof that an earlier upload was never persisted, or proof that the official App would display a returned row.

native_apk.inspection: Read classes10.dex using baksmali. APK application code was not executed.

findings.evidence: Its five serialized fields are key, start_time, end_time, reverse and next_key. startTime is nullable. There is no limit field.

The legacy fitness branch constructs GetFitnessDataByTime(key, null, endTime, true, nextKey), then calls FitnessDataRequest.getFitnessDataByTime. This is an existing native full-pull path, not an invented request model.

The serializer is constructed with new Gson() and serializes the request model. Default Gson omits null object fields; consequently the null startTime is omitted, rather than emitted as start_time:null.
The service annotation uses data/get_fitness_data_by_time. Its response model FitnessDataResultByTime provides data_list, has_more and next_key.

native_apk.scope_limit: Static request construction establishes a native request shape. It does not establish the current backend's completeness, current account routing, persistence behavior, or display behavior.

primary_public_sources.scope: Author's APK and read-only account investigation, including one UTC+8 account; not this user's account.
primary_public_sources.finding: The author reports 36 SpO2 rows from a no-start control, 27 from a window starting at the desired boundary, and 36 matching rows after moving the start back one day. A no-start page can still report more pages. Server-selected page size and one tested timezone do not guarantee universal completeness.
primary_public_sources.implication: The existing importer already overlaps the preceding day. The known initial-bucket omission alone therefore does not explain this user's 132 pending rows. A request without start_time remains a useful independent comparison.

primary_public_sources.scope: Author's own heart-rate reads and native request analysis; not a write acceptance test.
primary_public_sources.finding: The author reports 476 no-start rows across two pages and separately compares multi-page window reads with no-start reads: 269 in-range rows match exactly. The reported upper endpoint can be inclusive. These observations support explicit pagination and local exclusive-end filtering, but do not establish a general cursor bug or justify assuming every missing row was lost.

current_reader_comparison.existing_broad_lower_bound: One UTC day before the target's UTC day, clipped to epoch zero.
current_reader_comparison.existing_narrow_change: Same broad lower bound, with end_time reduced to the selected target's time plus one second.
current_reader_comparison.new_control_difference: Omit start_time and the non-native limit field. No claim is made that either field is the demonstrated cause of this user's missing observations.

bounded_control_contract.default_interface_behavior: UnsupportedOperationException for implementations without this capability; a diagnostic counts this as unqueried, not missing.
bounded_control_contract.completion: Only an explicit Boolean has_more=false with valid pagination metadata reports complete=true. It means the endpoint terminated this traversal, not that every backend representation was queried.
bounded_control_contract.incomplete: A cap, absent/null/non-Boolean has_more, invalid/missing cursor while more is true, or repeated cursor returns retained valid rows with complete=false. Old timestamps never establish early completion.
bounded_control_contract.errors: Transport, business rejection and malformed row errors still throw. Authentication expiry and cancellation propagate unchanged.
bounded_control_contract.bounds: The control read filters output to nonnegative times strictly below untilEpochSeconds. It has no lower time bound.
bounded_control_contract.probe_selection: Inspect RAW targets classified MISSING by broad reads, querying at most one key and ending just after that key's newest target. Additional keys remain unqueried.
bounded_control_contract.probe_missing_rule: An unreturned target is nativeMissing only when the traversal is complete. Otherwise it is nativeUnqueried. Observed semantic matches, mismatches and ambiguous identities retain their distinct counts.
bounded_control_contract.other_source_hint: Counts broad-MISSING targets with a nondeleted row at the same key/time/tag under an explicit different SID.
bounded_control_contract.deleted_hint: Counts broad-MISSING targets with a deleted row under the exact expected SID/key/time/tag. It may overlap the other-source count.
bounded_control_contract.privacy: Probe results contain counters only. No source SID, health measurement, timestamp, account identifier, request body or response body is included.
bounded_control_contract.mutation_policy: The diagnostic probe never uploads, marks verified, clears pending entries, or grants permission for later replay. Recovery separately requires all of its preconditions.

coverage: Native payload omits start_time and limit, preserves end_time/reverse and follows the returned cursor.
Explicit EOF on the final allowed page, safety caps, repeated or missing cursors, malformed pagination metadata, exclusive-end filtering and retained observations.
A recovery read may use 32 pages; older returned timestamps do not terminate pagination early.
Business failures, malformed rows, expired authentication and cancellation cannot become successful empty reads.
The 195/63/132 fixture can reveal 132 missing-window targets through native reads while keeping every pending journal entry locked.
Incomplete native traversal distinguishes observed matches from unqueried targets; only completed traversal can count unreturned targets as missing.
Unknown SID, mismatches, overlapping other-source/tombstone hints, bounded mixed-key queries, and unsupported read implementations remain distinct.

remaining_uncertainty: No live Xiaomi account read or upload was performed by this research task.
The independent request may or may not find any of the user's 132 pending targets.

A 32-page historical cap may remain incomplete for an account with extensive history. An unreturned target must then block a recovery write, not be treated as absent. A clearly observed match can still be reconciled without writing.
A returned semantic match proves observation of the uploaded fields through this endpoint at read time, not display in Mi Fitness or later retention.

Neither these notes nor the new control show that the unrecognized limit field, a timezone bucket, source SID rewriting, deletion, eventual consistency, or failed persistence caused the current problem. The extra read and hint counters distinguish some of those possibilities without assigning a cause in advance.
